description: This file defines a test base class for media pipeline testing, including setup and teardown methods, media pipeline creation and destruction, and state notification methods. It contains mock object management and test utility functions for media pipeline components.

classes.name: MediaPipelineTestBase
classes.description: A test fixture class providing setup, teardown, and utility methods for media pipeline unit tests.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes mock objects for media pipeline testing.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Resets mock objects and cleans up after tests.

methods.name: createMediaPipeline
methods.description: Creates and initializes a media pipeline object with mock dependencies.

methods.name: destroyMediaPipeline
methods.description: Destroys the media pipeline object and cleans up.

methods.name: setPlaybackState
methods.description: Simulates a change in playback state and notifies the media pipeline callback.

methods.name: setNetworkState
methods.description: Simulates a change in network state and notifies the media pipeline callback.

methods.name: needData
methods.description: Simulates a media data request from the media pipeline.
